name: Zotero CiteFlow
shortDescription: 追踪 Word 文档引用，并连接 Zotero 文献操作。
Track Word citations and connect them to Zotero items.
introduction: 面向使用 Zotero 与 Microsoft Word 写作的用户，在文献列表查看引用状态，维护插件管理的引用标签，并提供明确目标的拖拽引文操作。
For writers using Zotero and Microsoft Word: inspect citation status in the item list, maintain managed citation tags, and drag citations to an explicit target.
githubDescription: Track Word citations and connect them to Zotero items. Part of Zotero Flow.
